title: x402 failure: a used authorization is sent again (replayed nonce)
summary: A captured PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is sent a second time after it settled. The nonce is already used on the token contract, so verification fails and a second settlement is impossible.

steps.label: Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
steps.detail: Someone sends a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE that already paid for an earlier request, hoping to get the resource again.

steps.label: POST /verify
steps.detail: The server forwards the payload together with its own copy of the requirements.

steps.label: Simulate the transfer, then read the nonce state
steps.detail: At verify the TypeScript facilitator simulates transferWithAuthorization. The token contract rejects the used nonce, so the simulation reverts; a follow-up read of authorizationState(from, nonce) names the reason.

steps.label: Simulation reverts; authorizationState is true
steps.detail: EIP-3009 tokens record every used nonce and refuse to reuse it, so even a direct settlement attempt would revert.

steps.label: Return isValid false (nonce already used)
steps.detail: The TypeScript facilitator reports invalid_exact_evm_nonce_already_used. The spec does not list a separate code for this case.

steps.label: 402 with a fresh PAYMENT-REQUIRED
steps.detail: The server refuses the request and does not run the handler. A server that caches access per payment can also deduplicate with the payment-identifier extension. The reference server puts the verify reason, invalid_exact_evm_nonce_already_used, in the error field of the new PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
